E_abs_velocity_feature.single_factor: added absolute object-velocity input (finite diff, recomputed per step)
E_abs_velocity_feature.stability_note: the finite-diff velocity feature is fed back open-loop; stable on short free-slide windows (real v0) but diverges on full-episode rollout from rest (v0=0)

recommended_next_experiment: E_damping_intervention: directly test learned over-damping by adding a velocity-dependent decay / targeted free-slide loss, measured against held-out free-slide travel -- the positive test H_friction still lacks

H_friction.evidence: the under-travel (~-0.0522 m) persists under BOTH a velocity input and a larger horizon, and |bias| does not approach zero with K (floor +0.0168 m). Most consistent with learned over-damping, but NOT positively demonstrated -- a damping-targeted intervention (E_damping_intervention) is the decisive next test

H_velocity.evidence: absolute-velocity input did NOT reduce the free-slide under-travel bias (-0.0522->-0.0487 m, within seed spread) or endpoint error (0.0936->0.0922 m); moreover the velocity-feedback rollout is UNSTABLE from rest (full-episode h20 diverged to 3.88 m vs baseline 0.065 m), so THIS remedy is contradicted while a stable velocity parameterization remains untested

H_horizon.evidence: free-slide |bias| does not fall toward zero as K grows: K1 0.017 -> K10 0.053 m (it grows, then plateaus)

H_coverage.evidence: E_add_freeslide_data not run; standing OOD->error (0.22) weakly argues against

gate_E_learning_benefit.note: measured independently of hypothesis discrimination; checkpoint rollback if no benefit
